examples.detection_method: Monitor email authentication failures (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) in mail gateway logs; detect new sending IPs outside corporate IP ranges; implement anomaly detection on executive accounts for unusual email sending volume and timing; verify large wire transfers with multi-factor out-of-band confirmation (phone calls); perform domain reputation and WHOIS checks on email sending domains.
